newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA TO SEND NAVAL DIVING TEAM TO COMOROS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA TO SEND NAVAL DIVING TEAM TO COMOROS.

text.p: South Africa said on Sunday it would send a navy diving team to the Comoros Islands to help retrieve bodies from the downed Ethiopian airliner which crashed after a hijacking by Ethiopian nationals.
South African Navy spokesman Stan Slogrove said the team of divers from Simon's Town was preparing to leave on Sunday night.
The request for help had come from the Ethiopian government.

"The diving team has been requested to assist with the recovery of bodies of the victims from a piece of the aircraft which is lying under way," Slogrove said in a statement. He said an update on the mission would be released later.
